exams.name: Electrician Licensure Examination
exams.notes: Written, oral, or computerized as approved by the board; includes National Electrical Code provisions. No limit on re-examination attempts, but a new application is required if not passed within one year.
exams.quote: Proctored examinations shall be written, written and oral, oral, or computerized as approved by the board. They shall include such provisions of the National Electrical Code as the board may deem appropriate.

required.quote: Each licensee shall show proof of completion of continuing education requirements adopted under this section within 12 months from the January 1 following the publication date of the latest version of the NFPA 70.

value: NFPA 70 / National Electrical Code compliance
topical_requirements.quote: continuing education applicable to all licensees for training and compliance with the latest published edition of the NFPA 70, National Electrical Code

available.quote: All boards or commissions shall grant a license to an individual certified or licensed in another state if it determines that the requirements or standards for certification or licensure in that state are equivalent to, or greater than, those established in New Hampshire.
available.citation: [UMBRELLA / Chapter 332-G - General Administration of Regulatory Boards ] Section 332-G:12 - Reciprocity Information.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current and valid license from another state with requirements equivalent to or greater than New Hampshire's. Board posts list of qualifying states. May also include completion of an NH-law examination and payment of a fee.
requirements.quote: Such terms, conditions, and criteria, may include, but shall not be limited to, the successful completion of an examination addressing the laws of the state of New Hampshire and the payment of a fee.
requirements.citation: [UMBRELLA / Chapter 332-G - General Administration of Regulatory Boards ] Section 332-G:12 - Reciprocity Information.

license_tiers.quote: "Apprentice electrician" means a person who is engaged in learning and assisting in making electrical installations under the direct supervision of a master or journeyman electrician. … "Journeyman electrician" means a person doing work of installing electrical wires … "Master electrician" means a person either employed by another master electrician or who, as a business, hires or employs another … "High/medium voltage electrician" means a person who, as a business, hires or employs another … to make electrical installations on high/medium voltage power distribution systems operating at over 600 volts

value: Persons under jurisdiction of the public utilities commission, FCC, or ICC making installations in the course of employment

Persons licensed under RSA 153:27 through 153:38 performing work governed by their license
scope_exclusions.quote: This chapter shall not apply to the following

apprentice_supervision_ratio.value: Up to 2 apprentices per journeyman or master electrician; first-year journeymen limited to 1 apprentice; maximum 6 licensed electricians with 2 apprentices each on a single work site
apprentice_supervision_ratio.quote: A journeyman electrician may have 2 apprentice electricians under his or her direct supervision beginning on the first anniversary of the journeyman electrician's initial date of licensure.

qualifier_required.quote: The office may issue a license to corporations and partnerships engaged in the business of making electrical installations, provided that one or more officers or employees of any such corporation directly in charge of the business affairs of such corporation … is a licensed master electrician.

value: General electrical contractor (standard voltage): licensed master electrician
